_source: MSJ Club Directory 2026-27.xlsx (87 clubs) is authoritative for which clubs are official this year. Every directory club has a matched Instagram handle below; msj.ce is MSJ Cybersecurity/Ethical Hacking (email msj.ce.club2025@gmail.com) and msj.csf is California Scholarship Federation. Handles verified against live profiles 2026-08-24; NAHS, Universal Performers, Aviation and Red Cross re-pointed and re-verified 2026-09-06.

clubs.description: Student clubs listed in MSJ Club Directory 2026-27.xlsx - one handle per directory club (87)

disbanded_2026_27.description: Clubs from previous years that do not appear in MSJ Club Directory 2026-27.xlsx. Not official clubs this year, so not scraped - an account still existing does not make the club official. Kept for the record: if one of these turns out to be a 2026-27 club that simply renamed, move the handle back into "clubs".

privateAccounts.shss.missionsj: MSJ Sikh Honors and Service Society. Reported as a private account. Verified 2026-08: the profile exists (8 followers) but has 0 posts, and Apify did NOT return private=true - so it may be new rather than private. Either way there is nothing to scrape yet. If it is private, the apify backend will never see it; only SCRAPER_BACKEND=playwright could, and only if that account follows it.
